description: ImpAI builds (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c; the brain, impai_brain.c, impai_econ.c, impai_build.c): Comet Catcher with fixed starts, true line of sight, mapped, at Easy, so both branches of every handicap stub the economy reaches run each pass. Seat 0 is an idle human (ARM, StartPos1) with a Peewee on hold about 1100 world units south of seat 1's start (5184, 560) and a Flea on hold about 1100 north of seat 2's (5712, 7216); seat 1 is ImpAI (CORE, StartPos2, so the launch writes `seatai=1`) and seat 2 OTA AI (CORE, StartPos3). The `impai-eco` test group orders the Peewee onto seat 1's commander at GameTime 900 and the Flea onto seat 2's at 930, so the on-hit commander purge's site (row 18) runs for both seats. Neither can kill its commander before the group ends at 5400, answered or not: the Peewee's EMG does 8 a shot every 0.4 s (20 a second) from about GameTime 1500, 1100 wu at its 1.8 a tick, and the Flea's beam 10 a second, against a CORE commander's 3000 (the retail FBIs and weapons.tdf). The Peewee's range, 180, is inside the commander's laser's 200, so a commander that answers ends it in four shots; the Flea's 300 outranges it. One unit each: three Peewees on each commander left none of seat 2's units at GameTime 5400 (MEASURED 2026-11-12). Comet Catcher has 3 to 7 metal spots within 1024 of each of its first four starts and a wind of 10..15 (scout I11), so the extractors come from spots and the energy from solar.
